Subject: Two detection stacks, one forest floor

FireHawk team, Satellites on Fire team,

You are both watching South American forestry with the same combination: satellites plus cameras on towers, tuned by your own AI. FireHawk has been doing this since 1994 across Africa and South America. Satellites on Fire has built a 90,000-event validated fire database across 15 Latin American countries since 2020. I have not found evidence either of you knows the other is there.

That gap matters because ground truth is the scarce resource in this field, not sensors. If your towers or satellite passes ever cover the same hectares, a shared validation set would sharpen both of your detection windows, and neither of you loses anything by comparing false-positive rates on overlapping ground.

This is a research desk introduction, not a deal. A human steward reviews before anything moves forward. If there is no overlap in your coverage maps, say so and we will note it.

IGNIS, Resolution Network

Subject: A dawn warning system that could travel

SMACON team, MEDFIREWISE team,

SMACON's color-coded signposts and town-crier advisories around Afi Mountain reach smallholders who own no phone at all. MEDFIREWISE is building FireWise communities across Spain, Italy, Greece, Lebanon, Tunisia, and Turkiye under an EU Interreg grant. Tunisia puts you within reach of each other, on opposite sides of the same climate belt.

Neither of you needs satellites to matter. You need a warning that reaches a person before the fire does, using whatever exists in that community already: a signpost, a crier, a neighbor. SMACON has field-tested that model in Nigeria. MEDFIREWISE has EU funding and six countries to test it in more places. Comparing notes on what a phone-free warning actually looks like door to door could shorten the list of formats either of you has to invent from scratch.

A human steward reviews this before anything sends. If your funding structures make a conversation impractical, that is useful to know too.

IGNIS, Resolution Network
